title: Giants rookie Arvell Reese ‘sprang onto the scene’ with monster Week 3 showing

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants rookie Arvell Reese ‘sprang onto the scene’ with monster Week 3 showing
sources.description: Arvell Reese had a bit of a chip on his shoulder after his sluggish Week 2 showing, and it certainly showed, as he put together his best performance yet against the Titans.
